import pytest
from rest_framework.test import APIClient


@pytest.mark.django_db
@pytest.mark.integration
def test_full_purchase_flow():
    client = APIClient()

    # ۱. ثبت‌نام
    register = client.post("/api/auth/register/", {
        "username": "sara",
        "email": "sara@example.com",
        "password": "S3cret!Pass",
        "password_confirm": "S3cret!Pass",
    }, format="json")
    assert register.status_code == 201
    client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Bearer {register.data['access']}")

    # ۲. مشاهده محصولات
    products = client.get("/api/products/")
    assert products.status_code == 200

    # ۳. ساخت سفارش
    product_id = products.data["results"][0]["id"]
    order = client.post("/api/orders/", {
        "items": [{"product": product_id, "quantity": 1}],
    }, format="json")
    assert order.status_code == 201

    # ۴. پرداخت (Mock)
    payment = client.post(f"/api/orders/{order.data['id']}/pay/", format="json")
    assert payment.status_code == 200

    # ۵. مشاهده سفارش پرداخت‌شده
    order_detail = client.get(f"/api/orders/{order.data['id']}/")
    assert order_detail.data["status"] == "paid"

import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_payment_success(authenticated_client, order):
    with patch("catalog.services.gateway.charge") as mock_charge:
        mock_charge.return_value = {"status": "success", "transaction_id": "tx_123"}

        response = authenticated_client.post(f"/api/orders/{order.id}/pay/")

        assert response.status_code == 200
        mock_charge.assert_called_once()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_payment_timeout(authenticated_client, order):
    with patch("catalog.services.gateway.charge") as mock_charge:
        mock_charge.side_effect = TimeoutError()

        response = authenticated_client.post(f"/api/orders/{order.id}/pay/")

        assert response.status_code == 502
        order.refresh_from_db()
        assert order.status == "pending"   # تراکنش برنگشته

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_order_atomic_on_failure(authenticated_client, product):
    initial_stock = product.stock

    payload = {
        "items": [
            {"product": product.id, "quantity": 5},
            {"product": 99999, "quantity": 1},   # محصول ناموجود
        ],
    }
    response = authenticated_client.post("/api/orders/", payload, format="json")

    assert response.status_code == 400

    # اطمینان از برگشت تراکنش
    product.refresh_from_db()
    assert product.stock == initial_stock

import pytest
from django.test.utils import CaptureQueriesContext
from django.db import connection


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_book_list_query_count(api_client):
    # ساخت ۱۰ کتاب با نویسنده
    BookFactory.create_batch(10)

    with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as queries:
        response = api_client.get("/api/books/")
        assert response.status_code == 200

    # حداکثر ۵ کوئری (auth + pagination + list + related)
    assert len(queries) < 8, f"N+1 detected: {len(queries)} queries"


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_book_detail_uses_select_related(api_client):
    book = BookFactory()

    with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as queries:
        response = api_client.get(f"/api/books/{book.id}/")

    assert len(queries) <= 3

from catalog.exceptions import InsufficientStock


def test_insufficient_stock_raises(authenticated_client, product):
    product.stock = 0
    product.save()

    payload = {
        "items": [{"product": product.id, "quantity": 1}],
    }
    response = authenticated_client.post("/api/orders/", payload, format="json")

    assert response.status_code == 409
    assert response.data["error"]["code"] == "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK"
    assert "موجودی" in response.data["error"]["message"]

exercises.title: تمرین — تست یکپارچگی
exercises.problem: یک تست یکپارچگی بنویسید برای جریان کامل ثبت‌نام → ساخت کتاب → ویرایش کتاب → حذف کتاب.
hints: از یک APIClient در همه مراحل.
exercises.solution:
```python
@pytest.mark.django_db
@pytest.mark.integration
def test_full_book_flow():
    client = APIClient()

    # ۱. ثبت‌نام
    register = client.post("/api/auth/register/", {
        "username": "sara",
        "email": "sara@example.com",
        "password": "S3cret!Pass",
        "password_confirm": "S3cret!Pass",
    }, format="json")
    assert register.status_code == 201
    client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Bearer {register.data['access']}")

    # ۲. ساخت کتاب
    create = client.post("/api/books/", {
        "title": "Clean Code",
        "author": "Robert C. Martin",
        "isbn": "9780132350884",
        "price": "42.50",
        "published_at": "2008-08-01",
    }, format="json")
    assert create.status_code == 201
    book_id = create.data["id"]

    # ۳. ویرایش
    update = client.patch(f"/api/books/{book_id}/", {"price": "39.90"}, format="json")
    assert update.status_code == 200
    assert update.data["price"] == "39.90"

    # ۴. حذف
    delete = client.delete(f"/api/books/{book_id}/")
    assert delete.status_code == 204

    # ۵. اطمینان از حذف
    get_after = client.get(f"/api/books/{book_id}/")
    assert get_after.status_code == 404
```
